picks.title: Otoy releases OctaneRender 2027.1 in alpha (updated for Alpha 3)
picks.excerpt: OctaneRender 2027.1's experimental build adds a real-time neural rendering mode built on DLSS-style ray reconstruction for near noise-free viewport renders, an updated AI Light system and USD export; Alpha 3 adds SDF-to-mesh baking.
picks.rationale: Concrete new release: neural rendering and AI Light change viewport look-dev for 3D/product visualisers right away.

picks.title: Which MCP server can design SVG and app UI? Eight compared (2026)
picks.excerpt: A hands-on comparison of eight MCP servers that let coding agents design app UI screens, icons and SVGs, covering which ones output editable design files versus raw code.
picks.rationale: Highly actionable tool-selection guide for designers wiring agents into UI/SVG work; freshest item in the pool.

picks.title: Adobe Max 2026's lineup tells us a lot about the company's AI priorities right now
picks.excerpt: Creative Bloq reads Adobe MAX 2026's session and speaker lineup as a map of where Adobe is steering its creative AI, from Firefly models and agentic assistants inside Photoshop and Premiere to how it pitches AI to working designers.
picks.rationale: Signals where the dominant creative suite's AI (Firefly, agentic assistants in Photoshop/Premiere) is heading ahead of MAX.

picks.title: With Meta's Muse Charm, AI enters its kawaii era
picks.excerpt: To sell AI hardware to the masses, Meta is going kawaii: the Muse Charm is a Tamagotchi-like handheld that personifies its Muse agent as a fuzzy, nameable mascot, a deliberate design move against AI's image problem.
picks.rationale: The single Muse pick: a design-lens read on personifying an AI agent through character design; distinct from gadgets' Muse items (shopping test, call-center leak).

picks.title: MathWorks introduces MATLAB and Simulink Release 2026b
picks.excerpt: Release 2026b adds AI-assisted profiling through Simulink Copilot, a Visual Inspection Toolbox mixing AI and image processing, and PyTorch co-execution for hardware-software co-design workflows.
picks.rationale: New release with Simulink Copilot and AI visual inspection for engineering/co-design teams; rounds out the CAD/engineering slot.
